correctness.rationale: For all algebraically closed characteristic-two fields and all nonzero lambda, the first Witt-coordinate pole argument forces affine base scaling 1; h0 constant and degree bounds on h1 make the cubic coefficient invariant. The translated class has exact linear coefficient T=lambda beta^2+beta+sqrt(lambda beta); the inversion class is represented by linear coefficient 1. The additive separable quartic has four roots at each of two disjoint targets, proving the normalizer and centralizer orders and elementary-abelian quotient. The standalone exact GF(4096) checker verifies polynomial identities and finite cases but is not used for the universal quantifier.

Equivariant uniqueness settles whether this is a redundant or actual moduli coordinate for wild genus-two C4 actions, and exact normalizer/centralizer formulas describe intrinsic stabilizers of those marked actions, including exceptional unmarked curves. This is a complete, naturally posed structural classification, not an arbitrary finite computation.
